description: Every reference resolves at doi.org (registry) or is a reachable URL; ledger required
Registered title must match bib title (>= 0.85 similarity)
Year (+/-1) and first author must match registry
OpenAlex retraction flag blocks
Cited preprints must be labelled 'preprint' in the citing sentence
URL-only references must be reachable
Every citation needs a CLAIM_SUPPORT row
Every cited source has saved text with ACCESS header; quotes must occur verbatim
Consensus wording needs >= 3 citations
Novelty wording must be hedged
p-value misinterpretation and significance spin
'±' must say SD/SE/CI
No false precision (>= 5 decimals)
Tortured phrases
Hype words
>= 10 logged queries over >= 3 sources
>= 1 counter-evidence search logged
Grey/regional literature searched
Each search row keeps its raw tool output; hit counts match
Novelty verdict has contrary-evidence and search-limitation sections
Proposal lint: falsifiable hypotheses, decision rules, data, validation
Research questions must not presuppose answers
Protocol SHA-256 frozen at S2; changes only as dated deviations
Method-conditional protocol requirements (24 rules)
Raw data hashed and read-only
Data provenance: URL, license, path
Data schema: units, types, ranges, date formats, mangled values
Personal data requires an ethics statement
Successful logged runs and passing tests after freeze
Result files must equal the output of a logged run and not be stale
No synthetic fallbacks, silent excepts or suppressed warnings in analysis code
Numeric-coded categoricals wrapped as factors in formulas
Pinned environment lock file
Dependencies exist and are >= 90 days old
Tests/evaluation code locked after S4
Split manifest: no group in train and test
Independent re-computation within tolerance
p-values recomputed from statistics
Every number traced to an exact cell
Performance numbers must not come from training data
Every protocol hypothesis reported
Limitations section >= 120 words
AI usage log and declaration consistency
Required sections, no placeholders or [VERIFY]
Figures script-generated from logged runs, error bars declared
Four independent reviewer reports, no self-scoring
At least one reviewer differs from the drafting model
Participant quotes must occur in raw transcripts
Prompt-injection scan of sources; human acknowledgement required
Journal verified by owner with source and date
Downloaded guide for authors required
Rebuttal 'Change' quotes must exist in manuscript
Approvals refused in agent sessions / non-TTY
Claude Code project permissions deny protected paths and human-only commands
Last failed run blocks (stop on failure)
Random spot-check sample shown at S8 approval
Cumulative gates; regression clears later passes
Processed data require a cleaning log (rows in/out, rule, script)
Every pre-registered analysis (A#) executed by a logged run or recorded as a deviation; false no-deviation claims blocked
Each provenance row with a file:line location must still find its value on that manuscript line (no stale bindings after edits)
Leading-dot (r = .85), inequality (p < .001, must hold for the cell), n = <year-range> numbers need provenance; bare numbers in code spans blocked
Author-year, LaTeX and numeric citations blocked: only [@citekey], which is registry- and quote-checked
Source texts (literature/text) must be written by rosctl fetch-text; a hand-written text cannot carry a quote
A script that writes results/ but reads no data or upstream file is blocked (typed-in results)
RECOMPUTATION_AUDIT rows must be written by a logged re-computation run, never typed
Unchecked manuscript sources (.tex/.docx) blocked; underscore drafts warned at S7 and blocked at S9
I read the three closest papers in full text myself (not only abstracts or AI summaries).
Novelty rests on evidence, not on missing search hits; the contrary evidence was examined; the method is not an old one renamed.
Regional, grey and non-English sources relevant to the setting (national institutes, theses, reports) were searched.
The agent challenged my idea; time, budget, data, equipment and software are realistic.
The sources cited in NOVELTY_VERDICT really say what is attributed to them, and they are primary sources.
The design matches the question; causal claims only where the design identifies causation; controls and confounders are listed.
Experimental unit, replication, blocking and season/location effects are correct (no pseudoreplication).
Sample size/power and every protocol constant (doses, rates, varieties, seasons, local units, standards) come from cited official sources.
Model choices are right: fixed vs random effects, sum-of-squares type, transformations, assumption checks, post-hoc tests, interactions.
I verified the randomly sampled numbers against the results files and the sampled claims against the source passages.
No overstatement: no may->does, lab->field, correlation->causation, untested mechanisms, or generalisation beyond sites, seasons and populations.
Figures, tables, captions and supplement agree with the text; axes are not misleading; error bars are defined.
Methods describe only what was actually done (checked against RUN_LOG, scripts and the cleaning log).
Synthesis is honest: contradictions reported not averaged away; publication bias, small-study effects, double-counted trials, heterogeneity, context transfer and hedges handled.
Terminology, Bangla<->English translations, equations and notation are correct and consistent.
Negative and contrary results are reported; limitations are specific and not spun.
All analysis runs, including exploratory and failed ones, are disclosed (no garden of forking paths).
Benchmark contamination and domain pitfalls (genome versions, repository-mining filters, survey validity, qualitative coding) are addressed.
The AI usage log (models, versions, dates, prompts) is complete enough to reproduce the AI-assisted steps.
At least one reviewer was a human or a different model family; AI output was not verified only by the same AI.
I can explain and defend every analysis and claim myself, without the AI.
For every row of PROTOCOL_EXECUTION I opened the code and confirmed it implements the protocol definition (baseline, split, metric, sample), not only that a number exists.
Ethics approval, consent, funding, acknowledgements, author contributions and data-availability statements are true and documented.
Journal facts (scope, indexing, quartile, APC, AI policy, author guidelines) were verified on official sites; the journal is not predatory.
An institutional similarity check was run; there is no close paraphrase; third-party figures/tables have permission.
No confidential or unpublished data or manuscripts were given to AI services that the applicable policies forbid.
Automated checker outputs were reviewed for false positives/negatives instead of being trusted blindly.
